_comment: PENDING first run. Concurrency/stability stress test for the only 2 motor-mounted channels on this ESC instance (channels 1 and 3), using the natural production layout - channel 1 on PIO0 (sm0/rx1), channel 3 on PIO1 (sm4/rx5), separate blocks (not the artificially-shared-PIO0 config from two_channel_bidir_smoke.json's decisive cross-talk test). Both start at throttle 60, hold 5s, ramp together to 200 over 5s, then diverge for the remaining 50s: motor 1 accelerates 200->300, motor 3 decelerates 200->100 - the divergent trend is corroborating evidence on top of CRC-valid% (the primary corruption signal): if there were any cross-talk between the two channels' RX state machines, the eRPM traces would show it as an implausible merge/aliasing between the two diverging curves, not just as CRC failures. Channels 2 and 4 held idle (TX-only, no motor mounted) - channel 4 is separately known-bad and parked, not exercised here. min_record_rate_hz=450: conservative floor below the ~514.6/s observed for 2 bidir channels sharing one PIO block (two_channel_bidir_smoke.json, 15437 records/30s) - this run's channels are on separate blocks so should be at least as good, but unmeasured for this exact layout/duration until this run completes.
